FN-F33HD5C-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 330
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Matt Woods
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/02/2024
House Bill 330 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of public
institutions of higher education to provide an annual report regarding funding received from
certain foreign entitites.

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 330
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Matt Woods
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/03/2024
House Bill 330 as reported by the Committee on Education Policy would increase the
administrative obligations of public institutions of higher education to provide an annual report
regarding funding or gifts received from certain foreign entities.
